detectionScenario.anchorFilter: fundId + occurredAt >= shockAt + submittedAt >= shockAt + rawScore >= tau

disclosureDetectionLagSec.R0: epoch-aligned, varies with run clock within [systemLag, systemLag + 604800); smoke asserts disclosedAt % 604800 == 0

detectionScenario.aggregateThresholdCensoring: tau=6000 equals the public red band boundary, so no rows are censored in the baseline scenario; non-boundary thresholds yield censored(threshold_not_identifiable) for aggregate-granularity public views

slither.triage: one mapping-default-initialization false positive, one intentional zero-supply division guard, timestamp findings accepted for four-timestamp ordering/audit semantics, and two consumer-interface inheritance suggestions; no finding is represented as a production security certification

independentReproduction.result: all non-PostgreSQL checks passed with 83 contract tests, 87 API tests and 98.55% contract line coverage; PostgreSQL 16 persistence and causal timestamp invariants were independently exercised by the master CI run

notes: The dependency-hardening release upgrades Fastify to 5.10.0, viem to 2.55.10, the application baseline to Node 22, and GitHub Actions to Node-24-based major releases without changing Chapter 3 business semantics.
Production dependency audit findings were reduced from 11 high, 3 moderate and 1 low to zero; CI now rejects future high-or-critical production findings.
Risk inputs were read at one fixed block and committed with payload schema version 3 (chainId + registry address + fundId + snapshot block domain binding).

Subscription mints shares as SubscriptionAmount*1e18/NAV on-chain; post-initial NAV is computed on-chain as NetAssetValue*1e18/TotalSharesSnapshot with the share snapshot read from the token at a fixed block; redemption records the settlement-time NAV and cash amount. Math.mulDiv floors in the fund-favorable (anti-dilutive) direction.
FundToken is immutably bound to its NAVRegistry; the API validates fundId and registry binding at startup and refuses to start on mismatch (asserted end-to-end).
Risk submission, liquidity submission, and gate release roles were assigned to separate accounts and removed from admin after deployment (Deploy.t.sol + on-chain cast checks).

Risk API payload schema version 3 has a golden-hash regression test; risk submission, chain readers, disclosure views, and route registration are separated into focused modules with no TypeScript `as any` assertions.
Observed timestamps use the API access time with the latest chain block and observed record as causal lower bounds; smoke and PostgreSQL restart evidence reject negative observation lag.
ShellCheck and Slither evidence is retained separately; all 21 Slither findings are manually classified in docs/chapter3-static-analysis.md and are not represented as a production security audit.
Smoke is a compressed functional test; the dedicated scenario output is the evidence source for all three DetectionLag measures.

Complete raw logs and evidence files are retained in the GitHub Actions artifacts referenced above; SHA-256 digests for all 14 functional evidence files and 4 static-analysis files are recorded in docs/evidence/chapter3-artifact-sha256.txt and docs/evidence/chapter3-static-analysis-sha256.txt.
